dialogs.text: To the great runner, Wanjiru.
(A weathered old stone tablet, most of its inscription is worn away...)
...Kiongozi has been gone for over a decade...
...great victory...
...built this shrine... honor the fallen...
(A weathered old stone tablet, most of its inscription is worn away...)
...Bakunawa's revival...
...before the return... must block the Mare Jivari... hold back the Black Tide...
...if I fail and fall... let those who come after... — Gloharry
(A weathered old stone tablet. The inscription is nearly illegible, but a faint name can still be seen at the bottom.)
(A weathered old stone tablet. The inscription is nearly illegible, but a faint name can still be seen at the bottom.)
(A weathered old stone tablet. The inscription is nearly illegible, but a faint name can still be seen at the bottom.)
(A weathered old stone tablet, most of its inscription is worn away...)
...I cloak the Enigmatic Land, and shroud this palace...
...only the legacy of heroes may awaken... — Shulevitz
(A badly-damaged, wind-worn booklet, with only a few words still legible...)
...seal the borders, contain the Mare Jivari... not a task for just one generation...
...my time runs short... put my thoughts in the Sacred Flame... remember, you who follow... — Cochanina
(A more recent booklet, containing just a few more elegant and joyful words...)
Task complete. Now I sing! — Isaja
To the Border Master, Sanhaj Kompore. His remains are buried here.
To the brave Menilek.
To the young Burkina.
To the chief of the mines, Sundjatta.
To the giant, Tupac.
To the everlasting Tenoch. His remains are buried here.
...In the distance... The faint outline of structures...
...Familiar shapes... from... or maybe...
...Impossible... to... investigate...
...Remember... all that happened...
